Let $F=GH.$ What is the value of ${f}_{12}$, if

$$
G=[\begin{aligned}2 & 3 \\ 4 & -2\end{aligned}],\,H=[\begin{aligned}-1 & 3 \\ 6 & 5\end{aligned}]?
$$

feedback.problem:
Let $C=AB.$ What is the value of ${c}_{21}$, if

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}3 & 2 \\ 5 & -1\end{aligned}],\,B=[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 \\ 3 & 4\end{aligned}]?
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
Multiplying the $2$nd row in $A$ by the $1$st column in $B$, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{c}_{21} & =[\begin{aligned}5 & -1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}1 \\ 3\end{aligned}] \\  & =5\cdot 1+(-1)\cdot 3 \\  & =5-3 \\  & =2.\end{aligned}
$$
